title: CLCON/18/2020 of SAHKARI MATSYA JEEVI SAMITI LTD. Vs SUSHIL KUMAR

paras.text:
I.A. No. 6135 of 2020 (Misc. Application)
I.A. No. 6136 of 2020 (Misc. Application)
I.A. No. 6137 of 2020 (Misc. Application)
In
CLCON No. 18 of 2020
Hon'ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.

Mr. Parikshit Saini, Advocate for
the petitioner.
 Mr. Vinod Nautiyal, Mrs. Mamta
Bisht, Deputy Advocate General, Mr. R.C.
Arya, Mr. S.K. Mishra, Mr. Sudhir Singh
and Mr. Pradeep Hariya, Standing
Counsel, Mr. Atul Bahuguna, Mr. V.S.
Rawat, Mr. J.S. Bisht, Mr. R.C. Joshi, Mr.
Gajendra Tripathi, Ms. Sangeeta
Bhardwaj & Mr. M.S. Bisht, Brief Holder
for the State of Uttarakhand.
Response affidavits filed on behalf of
respondents are taken on record. The
misc. applications, made therefor, stand
disposed of.
Heard learned counsel for the
parties through video conferencing.
This Contempt Petition has been
filed by Sahkari Matsya Jeevi Samiti Ltd.
alleging willful disobedience of the order
dated 13.06.2018 passed by Division
Bench of this Court in WPPIL No. 65 of
2011 "Kunwarpal Singh Vs. State of
Uttarakhand & others". In the said PIL,
following directions were issued:
"6. Accordingly, the following mandatory
directions are issued to the State
Government:-
A. The State Government is directed to
remove all the encroachments from the
village ponds/johars, play grounds and
common grazing land within a period of
six months from today.

B. The State Government is also directed
through Secretary Revenue to ensure that
all the illegal entries changing the nature
of the ponds/ common grazing land/ johar
are reversed and the land is restored to its
original nature, and if necessary, by
carrying out digging up operations.
C. The State Government is also directed
through the respective SDMs to ensure
that all the johars/ponds/water bodies are
fenced and protected.
D. The State Government through office of
Chief Secretary is directed to ensure that
henceforth, no johar/ponds/water bodies/
common grazing land is encroached by
anyone through the State of Uttarakhand.
E. The State Government is also directed
to ensure that no sewerage flows into the
water bodies and their water quality is
maintained throughout the year. The
endeavor of the State Government should
be to restore the village ponds/water
bodies, as they existed in the year 1951
when the U.P. Z.A. & L.R. Act was made
applicable.
G. The Sub Divisional Magistrates of the
respective areas are directed to constitute
a Committee comprising of six members
including the Pradhan of the Panchayat to
identify and locate the ponds/water bodies
in their respective jurisdiction."
Response affidavits have been filed
by all the three respondents in this
Contempt Petition. Paragraph no. 7 of
the response affidavit filed by Mr. Sushil
Kumar, In-Charge Secretary, Revenue
Department, Government of
Uttarakhand, Dehradun is extracted
below:
"7. That according to the report of the
revenue team in Khasra No. 992Ka which

is recorded as "Johar" having area of
2.8670 hectare and Khasra No. 992Kha
having area 1.2290 hectare is recorded as
"Abadi". But in the map the area of Khasra
No. 992 is shown less and at present there
is a difference in the area shown in the
records and in the area shown in the map.
Further, it was stated in the report that
Khasra No. 594 area 0.3070 hectare is
recorded in the name of Junior High
School Manakpur Adampur and according
to the settlement Khasra No. 594 Ka area
0.0600 hectare whose old no. is 259/1;
Khasra No. 594 Kha area 0.0100 hectare
whose old no. is 259/2 and Khasra No.
594 Ga area 0.2370 hectare whose old no.
is 259/3, which is made from Khasra No.
259 area 1 bigha 10 biswa pukhta i.e.
0.3070 hectare, is recorded as "Banjar" in
Shreni-5. Thus according to the
settlement Khasra No. 594 was recorded
in the name of Junior High School
Manakpur Adampur and not as "Johar".
According to the present revenue records
the "Johar" in question Khasra No. 992
Ka. area 2.8670 hectare is in its original
position of "Johar" and there is no
encroachment was found upon the same."
Mr. J.S. Bisht, learned Brief Holder
submits that land comprised in Khasra
No. 594 Ga is recorded as "Banjar" in
revenue records in Category-V and it is
presently recorded in the name of Junior
High School Manakpur, Adampur and it
is not recorded as "Johar" (water body),
as alleged by the petitioner. Thus,
learned State Counsel submits that there
is no question of encroachment over the
said land.
Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that, pursuant to the order of
this Court, the Revenue Authorities have
stopped Gram Pradhan from filling the

Pond, thus, the order of this Court stands
complied with.
In view of statement so made by
learned counsel for the petitioner,
nothing survives in this Contempt
Petition.
Accordingly, Contempt Petition is
dismissed.
Contempt notices issued to the
respondents are hereby discharged.
However, petitioner shall be at
liberty to approach this Court, in case
encroachment is made on the "Johar"
land in future.
